name: Shiyakusho
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood city hall: a reception-hours notice, a first visit to get a resident certificate, a fee info sheet, a trial self-service kiosk, new-staff training plans, counter manners, teaching a colleague the application system, the history of online applications, a service guide, a hybrid appointment system, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
